title: Quick Reference Card: Loyalty Credit on Cardinal Personal Auto Policy Driver Additions
content:
**Cardinal Personal Auto Policy, driver additions.** The loyalty credit percentage of a driver addition charge follows the named insured's Cardinal tenure. Tenure is counted in whole months from the policy's original inception date, as shown on the policy record, to the day the charge is booked.

- **60 months or more:** 10 percent.
- **36 months or more but under 60:** 5 percent.
- **Under 36 months:** nil.

**Edges.** At exactly 60 whole months the credit is 10 percent; at 59 it is 5 percent. At exactly 36 it is 5 percent; at 35 it is nil.

**Example (hypothetical).** A policy first incepted 1 June 2022, with a driver addition charge booked 1 October 2026: tenure is 52 whole months, so the credit is 5 percent. Booked instead on 1 June 2027, tenure is 60 whole months and the credit is 10 percent.
